patch_description: The previous multi-parameter (n_params=20) design scored lower (0.68) than the earlier single-shared-parameter design (n_params=8, score=0.80). Revert to the highly parameter-efficient single-scalar "theta" scheme (RX+RY pre-rotation, CZ ring, antipodal CRZ, RZ post-rotation) that achieved the best combined score, and augment it with the recommended zero-parameter "skip-2" CZ links (connecting each qubit to its distance-2 neighbor) to increase entangling connectivity (degree-4 connectivity) without adding any trainable parameters. This should improve expressivity/generalization while keeping n_params at 8, likely recovering and possibly exceeding the 0.80 score.
